DashboardRenter.noInvestment: No investments for this user yet
DashboardRenter.rentDiscountInfo: The more tokens you have, the lower the rent.
DashboardRenter.rentValueFeeInfo: The Rental Management Fee is 10% of the total rent, but since the property is co-owned, you only pay the portion proportional to your share of the property. The greater your ownership stake, the lower your rent — and the greater your share of responsibility.
DashboardRenter.condominiumInfo: The amount that all residents pay to keep the building running. This fee is set by the condominium itself, not by Firmeza, and is not related to the rent amount.
DashboardRenter.propertyTaxInfo: Amount of taxes paid to the City Hall and/or Fire Department, not related to the rental value.
DashboardRenter.scheduledTokenPurchaseInfo: You chose to invest {amount} every month. You can adjust it anytime.
DashboardRenter.scheduledTokenPurchase2Info: You chose to invest a quantity by month. You can adjust it anytime.
DashboardRenter.fractionAcquisitionFeeInfo: When you purchase a fraction of the property, you pay a 7.5% fee on the purchase amount. This fee covers the operational costs.
DashboardRenter.maintenanceInfo: A copropriedade envolve também a coresponsabilidade pelos custos de manutenção. Isso significa que despesas com pequenos reparos, consertos e ajustes necessários para manter o imóvel em boas condições são compartilhadas entre os coproprietários, de acordo com suas respectivas proporções de participação.
DashboardRenter.rentReductionInfo: Your rent decreases proportionally with each token purchased.
DashboardRenter.rentReductionInfoLegacy: The greater your share in the property, the higher the monthly rent you receive. All months, 10% of the rent value of this property is allocated to Legacy Customers, distributed proportionally to the number of tokens each one has. Over time, as the tenant repurchases tokens, your share in the property decreases and, consequently, the rent amount received also decreases.
DashboardRenter.purchaseJourneyInfo: Each token represents $1 in the purchase of your property. With each token acquired, you advance more in realizing your dream of owning a home. The more tokens you accumulate, the closer you are to achieving your home!
DashboardRenter.propertyIsYours: of the property is already yours
DashboardRenter.paymentNotAvailableMessage: We'll notify you when the payment slip is available.
DashboardRenter.noMetadataAvailable: Data not available for this property. Please check if the property is configured correctly.
DashboardRenter.propertyNotConfigured: This property has not been configured in the system yet. Please contact the administrator.

DashboardInvestor.graphicSummaryLegacy: My Journey as a Legacy Customer
DashboardInvestor.graphicSummaryInfo: See how your share in the property generates monthly rent and how it changes over time as tokens are repurchased by the tenant.
DashboardInvestor.dueDateLegacyInfo: It is the estimated date for you to receive the monthly amount. If there is a delay in the tenant's payment, the date may be adjusted automatically until regularization.
DashboardInvestor.rentValueInfo: Every month, you receive the portion of the rent corresponding to your share in the property.
DashboardInvestor.rentValueInfoLegacy: Every month, 10% of the rent value of this property is allocated to Legacy Customers. You receive the proportional portion according to the number of tokens you have in this property.
DashboardInvestor.rePurchasedInfo: Part of your ownership in the property is repurchased monthly by the tenant until full acquisition.
DashboardInvestor.rePurchasedExtraInfo: In addition to the monthly automatic buyback, the tenant can purchase extra tokens anytime and get closer to achieving the dream of homeownership.
DashboardInvestor.feeValueInfo: Amount paid to Firmeza for property management, proportional to your share.
DashboardInvestor.maintenanceInfo: The co-ownership also involves shared responsibility for maintenance costs. This means that expenses for minor repairs, fixes, and necessary adjustments to keep the property in good conditions are shared among the co-owners, according to their respective proportions of ownership.
DashboardInvestor.rentReductionInfo: This amount refers to your share in the property. The greater your share, the higher the rent you receive monthly. Over time, as the tenant repurchases tokens, your share in the property decreases — and so does the rent amount received.
DashboardInvestor.rentYieldFeeInfo: Accumulated income is the sum of all rent payments you have received so far from this property.
DashboardInvestor.purchaseJourneyInfo: Each token represents R$1 in property ownership. Every month, the tenant repurchases part of your tokens until full ownership is achieved.
DashboardInvestor.purchaseJourneyLegacyInfo: Each token represents R$1 in property ownership. Every month, the tenant repurchases part of your tokens until full ownership is achieved.
DashboardInvestor.tokensRepurchasedInfo: It is the total number of tokens that the tenant has already purchased from you and you have already received.

tooltips.totalValue: This is the total cost of the maintenance, before being split among the co-owners.
tooltips.yourPropertyShare: This is your percentage share of the property. The maintenance cost is divided according to this percentage.
tooltips.proportionalValue: This is the amount of the maintenance you pay, calculated based on your share of the property.

MaintenanceTable.message: Co-ownership also involves shared responsibility for maintenance costs. This means that expenses for minor repairs, fixes, and necessary adjustments to keep the property in good condition are shared among co-owners, according to their respective ownership proportions. So far, there have been no recorded maintenance expenses.

RentAdjustment.messageNoData1: The rent amount can change once a year, based on the IGP-M (General Market Price Index), which is an inflation indicator. This adjustment usually happens on the contract anniversary month. As soon as the adjustment is made, you'll see the new amount here.
RentAdjustment.messageNoData2: Don't worry, we'll let you know beforehand!

RentAdjustmentByInvestor.currentRentInfo: Estimated amount you are expected to receive as rent, based on your current ownership share.
RentAdjustmentByInvestor.tokensRePurchasedInfo: Number of tokens that have been repurchased by the tenant.
RentAdjustmentByInvestor.currentParticipationInfo: Based on the number of tokens you own, we calculate your percentage of property ownership.
RentAdjustmentByInvestor.baseRentInfo: The base rent is the total monthly amount paid by the tenant. The amount you receive depends on your current share in the property.

RentDistributionAndRepurchasedTokensList.valueCoOwnerInfo: Every month, you receive the portion of the rent corresponding to your share in the property.
RentDistributionAndRepurchasedTokensList.repurchasedTokensInfo: Part of your ownership in the property is repurchased monthly by the tenant until full acquisition.
RentDistributionAndRepurchasedTokensList.feeInfo: Amount paid to Firmeza for property management, proportional to your share.
RentDistributionAndRepurchasedTokensList.maintenanceInfo: Co-ownership also means shared responsibility for maintenance costs. This includes expenses for minor repairs, fixes, and necessary adjustments to keep the property in good condition, divided among co-owners according to their ownership share.
